body.statement: For every \(C\in\mathfrak S_p\), \[\operatorname{Enum}(C)=\mathcal R(C)=\{D\in\mathfrak S_p:\mathsf S(D)=\mathsf S(C)\}.\] Each consistent extension of the ordinary CPDAG with the background arrows \(F(C)\) has exactly one lifted partition, so the enumeration is duplicate-free and terminates after at most \(p!\) outputs. A shortest legal-reversal path from \(C\) to each emitted \(D\) has length \(\delta(C,D)\).
body.justification: Exact equivalence becomes usable only when every compatible state and a shortest transformation certificate can be emitted without partition ambiguity.
body.gap: WienobstLuttermannBannachLiskiewicz2023 gives linear-delay consistent-extension enumeration with background knowledge but does not prove the blocked-partition lift or its equality with a coefficient-coloured covariance component.
body.consumer: The enumerated component supplies every member-labelled causal effect and every admissible singleton orientation for downstream analysis.
